drafts.title: Twenty Rooms
drafts.pitch: Same idea told straight: two views, twenty, Null waves, and Tilde says to wave at twenty rooms, then to wave anyway.
drafts.reason: Faithful and the 'maybe-rooms' exchange lands, but the wave is the only turn and Tilde's closer mostly restates the setup.

drafts.title: Maybe-Rooms
drafts.pitch: Same idea; Tilde tells Null to wave at twenty rooms, so Null does, one at a time, and loses count.
